summary: 26-year-old snowboarder Jeff Miller of Winter Park caught in a Monday-morning avalanche below the Fingers on the Grand County side of Berthoud Pass; he had forgotten his avalanche beacon in his car. After a nearly three-day search by teams from three counties, Miller's body was dug out from about 3 feet of snow Wednesday morning; his German Shepherd Beau was found dead nearby. Grand County Coroner conducted the autopsy.
location: Berthoud Pass, below the Fingers, Grand County side
responding_agency: Alpine Rescue Team, Grand County SAR, Grand County Sheriff
notes: Dog Beau also killed and recovered. Miller's beacon was in his car; companion's account per The Avalanche Review Vol. 36.2.
